name: spedf_tie_prio_5
notes: Phase-0 standard v3 async_batch. 3 small reads + 2 small writes, mixed submission (write first). sp_edf ignores ioprio entirely (lane-based, not prio-based; decorations kept to document that). SMALL_READ lane drains fully before SMALL_WRITE (bpf.c:133-135). Within-lane submission order == sector ASC, so the expected order is robust even under equal-arrival ties (bpf.c:89-91 sector fallback). Expected ISSUE: R102400, R102912, R103424, W101888, W102144 — a write submitted FIRST issues 4th, which proves the scheduler (not the submitter) chose the order.
